name: SVGO
category: A4. Vector, typography, diagrams and stills
role: SVG optimisation; preserve IDs needed by animation
summary: Node.js tool and library that optimises SVG by removing metadata, editor cruft and redundant attributes and by minifying paths. Run as the svgo CLI or from a script with a plugin config; output is smaller SVG. Its strength is a large plugin set. Default presets can strip or rename ids and viewBox that animation targets, so config must preserve them.
use_when: Shrinking SVG exported from Inkscape, Figma or Illustrator before it enters a scene
Cleaning Graphviz or Mermaid SVG output in a pipeline
Normalising SVG before diffing or hashing
avoid_when: The SVG is animated by id or class: disable cleanupIds and removeViewBox, or skip it
Rasterising only: resvg gets the same pixels without optimising
Hand-authored minimal SVG that is already small

assessment.rationale: npm 4.1.0 published 2026-08-24, with 2.8.4 backported the same day; MIT. De facto SVG optimiser; no neighbour covers it. The ID-preservation caveat in the role is a real risk with default presets.
